title: 5 weeks into the development of my Open-world Dungeon Crawler Game
author: Psychological-Arm42

comments.author: Psychological-Arm42
comments.body:
Spent the last two weeks pretty much entirely on building these bosses. 5 bosses (out of 9 total) are showcased in the video.  
Music is a placeholder generated by Suno, resembling the overall music direction of the game.  
UI is still placeholders, to be improved
